claims.statement: EUDR requires operators to collect product and supplier information, analyse risk, mitigate non-negligible risk, and maintain a due-diligence system before relevant products are placed on or exported from the EU market.
The Commission operates an EUDR Information System for submission and management of due-diligence statements, confirming that structured digital evidence is part of the mandated workflow.

Hypothesis: a reusable supplier-and-plot passport distributed through certifiers and commodity intermediaries will outperform one-off importer questionnaires because the same upstream evidence can serve repeated shipments and multiple buyers with permission.

contrary_evidence: The Commission's own Information System handles due-diligence statements, so a duplicate submission portal is not a viable wedge.
Applicability dates and treatment of legacy timber have been amended or clarified, showing material timing and scope volatility.

economics.acquisition_route: Enter one commodity through a certifier or importer-services partner with a repeat supplier base, then expand through its buyer network
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Hypothesis: 30000 active supplier/plot records at 15 PLN monthly blended net revenue plus channel fees could exceed 6 million PLN ARR in years 6-8; at 25% EBITDA, 6x EBITDA, and 70% ownership, founder equity could exceed 6 million PLN
economics.founder_time: 20-25 hours weekly for one-commodity MVP; target under 12 hours weekly after channel-led supplier onboarding and outsourced regulatory review
economics.gross_margin_basis: Automated geometry and document checks can support 75-90% software margin, but assisted supplier remediation may materially reduce it
economics.payback: Target partner CAC payback under 12 months; supplier passport reuse must reduce repeated onboarding enough to justify the fee
economics.pricing: Hypothesis: 20-80 PLN per active plot or supplier monthly, 100-400 PLN per shipment packet, and 40000-150000 PLN annual channel licences
economics.retention_or_repeat: Persistent plots and suppliers are reused across shipments, while periodic risk and document updates create recurring revenue

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Permissioned reuse of verified plot histories, supplier identities, document provenance, and observed exception patterns creates network density
fingerprint.customer: Smaller EU operators and traders in EUDR commodities, plus their certifiers, brokers, and ERP providers
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Embedded in certification workflows, commodity broker portals, and vertical procurement ERPs
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Permissioned supplier-and-plot passport network with validation API and partner white labelling
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Operator, certifier, or broker pays per active supplier/plot and per released evidence packet
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A purchase order or shipment cannot be released until plot, legality, chain-of-custody, and risk evidence is complete

founder_fit: Good data-pipeline, geospatial-validation, and EU compliance fit with global upside and no need for a public persona. Founder time stays bounded only if certifiers or brokers own supplier relationships and any field verification.
risks: False geolocation or legality evidence could expose customers to enforcement and supply interruption.
Supplier adoption across languages and low-connectivity regions may demand expensive assisted onboarding.
Rules may simplify further for smaller operators, reducing urgency.

structure.control_point: The evidence-complete release gate for a regulated commodity purchase order or shipment
structure.critical_dependency: Trusted upstream plot and legality data that partners are legally and commercially allowed to reuse

thesis: Build a lightweight EUDR plot and chain-of-custody evidence passport for smaller EU coffee, cocoa, wood, rubber, cattle, palm-oil, and soy operators. Certification bodies, commodity brokers, and vertical ERP resellers would issue and reuse supplier passports at purchase-order release, while the regulated operator retains the final due-diligence decision.
title: PlotProof Relay
uncertainties: Information System API availability and delegation permissions need confirmation.
Smallholders may lack reliable polygon, legality, or chain-of-custody data.
Existing traceability and certification platforms may already control the best distribution partners.
